title: Discord is ditching Electron and its new app uses less RAM

claims.claim: Discord, masaüstü uygulamasını Electron altyapısından Rust programlama diline taşıyacağını duyurdu.

evidence.quote: Discord is finally giving up on Electron, the cross-platform framework that lets developers build desktop apps using web technologies. Electron web apps are notoriously heavy on system resources, and Discord is now moving its desktop app fully to Rust
Discord is ditching Electron and its new app uses less RAM Discord is moving its apps fully over to the Rust programming language.

claims.claim: Discord, 2018 yılından beri Rust teknolojisini erken benimseyen şirketlerden biridir.

evidence.quote: “We’ve been early adopters of Rust since 2018
“We’ve been early adopters of Rust since 2018 and a lot of our infra, voice tech, and even some of the current client is already Rust

claims.claim: Discord'un altyapısının, ses teknolojisinin ve mevcut istemcisinin bir kısmında halihazırda Rust kullanılmaktadır.

evidence.quote: and a lot of our infra, voice tech, and even some of the current client is already Rust
“We’ve been early adopters of Rust since 2018 and a lot of our infra, voice tech, and even some of the current client is already Rust

claims.claim: Discord CTO'su Stanislav Vishnevskiy, Electron ve React Native'in kullanımdan kaldırılacağını açıkladı.

evidence.quote: “That means Electron goes away, and so does React Native
“That means Electron goes away, and so does React Native, mobile keeps native UI but shares app code with desktop via Rust.”

claims.claim: Discord'un yeni Rust tabanlı Windows istemcisi 290MB RAM tüketmektedir.

evidence.quote: Vishnevskiy also shared an image of the Discord Windows client using just 290MB of RAM

claims.claim: Mevcut Discord Windows uygulaması, birkaç sunucuya katılım durumunda 1GB veya daha fazla RAM tüketebilmektedir.

evidence.quote: you only have to participate in a few servers and RAM usage can easily hit 1GB or more using the current Windows app.

Vishnevskiy also shared an image of the Discord Windows client using just 290MB of RAM, which is a clear improvement as you only have to participate in a few servers and RAM usage can easily hit 1GB or more using the current Windows app.

claims.claim: Discord, mobil uygulamalarında yerel kullanıcı arayüzünü koruyup masaüstü ile ortak kod paylaşımını Rust üzerinden yapacaktır.

evidence.quote: mobile keeps native UI but shares app code with desktop via Rust.”
“That means Electron goes away, and so does React Native, mobile keeps native UI but shares app code with desktop via Rust.”

claims.claim: Discord, yeni Rust tabanlı uygulamayı yakın zamanda kullanıcılarla test etmeyi hedeflemektedir.

evidence.quote: It’s not clear when Discord will make the full switch over to Rust, but Vishnevskiy says the company “hope to get it into testing with users soon.”
